description: This file contains Sass mixins related to button styling, including variants, outline variants, and size configurations. It defines reusable style snippets for buttons with various states and options in a web project.

methods.name: button-variant
methods.description: Defines styling for button variants with customizable background, border, color, hover, active, and disabled states.

methods.name: button-outline-variant
methods.description: Defines outline styling variants for buttons with customizable colors for normal, hover, active, and disabled states.

methods.name: button-size
methods.description: Sets padding, font size, and border radius for buttons, enabling consistent sizing.
